About Moon Bay OPC

We help foreign entrepreneurs turn ideas into registered companies in Suzhou Industrial Park — China's most business-friendly zone for solo founders.

Our mission is simple: to make company registration in China accessible to every entrepreneur — regardless of nationality, capital, or experience. We believe that a great idea should never be blocked by bureaucracy.

Leadership

Meet the Founder

JC

Jessica Chang

常杰雅 · Founder & Director

Jessica Chang is a bilingual legal professional with over a decade of experience in Chinese corporate law and foreign investment regulations. After years of helping multinational companies navigate complex WFOE setups, she recognized a gap: there was no simple, affordable path for individual entrepreneurs to start a business in China.

In April 2026, Jessica founded Moon Bay OPC with a single goal — to make the One-Person Company structure accessible to foreign founders. Her team became the first to successfully register a 100% foreign-owned OPC in Suzhou Industrial Park, establishing a precedent that has since opened doors for entrepreneurs worldwide.

Jessica holds dual qualifications in Chinese and international business law. She is a frequent speaker at entrepreneurship events across China and has been featured in major media outlets for her pioneering work in foreign company registration. She is passionate about building a community where solo founders can thrive, connect, and grow together.

Under her leadership, Moon Bay OPC has grown from a single-person practice to a full-service registration firm serving clients from over 20 countries — while maintaining the personal, founder-first approach that started it all.

Our Journey

Company Timeline

First Foreign OPC License
